Dublin Marathon Expo 2027

When: Friday 22 October 2027, 10:00 to 20:00, and Saturday 23 October 2027, 09:00 to 18:00.

Where: RDS Simmonscourt, Ballsbridge, Dublin 4.

Runners collect race packs at the expo on the two days before the marathon. Bring photo ID and your confirmation email. The expo hall has stands from local running clubs, physiotherapists and kit sellers, with talks on pacing and nutrition throughout both days.
